paper_000_chameleon.key_relevance: Early-fusion token-based mixed-modal model - the primary single-encoder baseline
paper_000_chameleon.architecture: Shared Transformer with discrete image tokens (BPE tokenizer, 8192 image codebook)
limitations: training instability requiring careful norm control

performance.VQA: State-of-the-art on VQA and captioning benchmarks
performance.generation: Non-trivial image generation but not competitive with dedicated models

paper_001_llava.key_relevance: Late-fusion understanding-only approach - understanding encoder baseline
paper_001_llava.architecture: CLIP ViT visual encoder + Vicuna LLM with linear projection
key_innovations: Visual instruction tuning with GPT-4 generated data
limitations: single visual encoder for understanding only

performance.chat: 85.1% relative score vs GPT-4 on LLaVA-Bench

paper_002_siglip.key_relevance: Sigmoid loss for contrastive learning - relevant to understanding encoder training
paper_002_siglip.architecture: ViT image encoder + Transformer text encoder with sigmoid contrastive loss
paper_002_siglip.insights_for_dve: Understanding encoder should use sigmoid contrastive loss for better small-batch performance and noise robustness

paper_003_llamagen.key_relevance: Autoregressive generation-only approach - generation pathway baseline
paper_003_llamagen.architecture: Llama architecture with VQGAN-style image tokenizer (downsample 16, codebook 16384)
paper_003_llamagen.insights_for_dve: Generation encoder should use discrete tokenization with downsample ratio 16, large codebook (16384), low vector dimension (8)

additional_contract_updates.generation_encoder_design: LlamaGen-style VQ tokenizer with downsample 16, codebook 16384, dim 8
additional_contract_updates.backbone_design: Chameleon-style autoregressive Transformer with QK-norm and z-loss
additional_contract_updates.key_advantage_claim: Decoupling allows understanding encoder to preserve semantic fidelity while generation encoder preserves visual reconstruction quality
